text:
FOMC minutes from the June 16–17 meeting confirmed a divided Fed: while the committee held rates at 3.50%–3.75%, several members advocated for further tightening, pushing the implied probability of a September hike to 70%. The 10-year Treasury yield climbed to 4.58%, and the DXY reached 101.26 as safe-haven demand intensified following the collapse of the US-Iran ceasefire and Brent crude's 6% surge above $78/bbl.

Bitcoin absorbed the dual shock with relative resilience, consolidating near $62,600 as U.S. spot ETFs recorded $143 million in net inflows — the third consecutive positive session. EDX Markets, backed by Citadel Securities and Fidelity Digital Assets, closed a $76 million Series C round, underscoring that institutional infrastructure is expanding even as spot prices compress. The S&P 500 shed 0.91% to 7,435; rising real yields and a firm dollar continue to weigh mechanically on non-yielding risk assets, keeping Bitcoin range-bound until the Fed's policy trajectory clarifies.
